examples.en: This was a significant difference between calls and gestures, Dr. Hobaiter said.
examples.zh: 霍拜特博士说，这是呼叫和手势之间的一个显著区别。

examples.en: Dr Catherine Hobaiter, who led the research, said that this was the only form of intentional communication to be recorded in the animal kingdom.
examples.zh: 领导这项研究的凯瑟琳·霍拜特博士说，这是动物王国中唯一被记录的有意图的交流方式。

examples.en: "The big message from this study is that there is another species out there, that is meaningful in its communication, so that's not unique to humans," said Dr. Hobaiter.
examples.zh: 霍拜托特博士说：“这项研究的重要信息是，还有另一个物种在进行有意义的交流，所以这并不是人类独有的。”
